title: WebGPU ReSTIR Direct Illumination in Rust and WGSL
description: Build ReSTIR direct illumination with WebGPU, Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Resample local lights across pixels and frames, trace BVHs, and denoise HDR output.
imageAlt: Animated Jax character walking through the Crytek Sponza atrium under WebGPU ReSTIR direct illumination, with reservoir controls open.
